title: Control pending commits and infinite-class occupation under independent errors
statement: Uniform over independent relative errors<=1/2. Fixed exposure length ell=10(A0+1)(D0+A0+L0+5),q=2ell,M=q+3,h=2M+q+10,kstar=h+3 precedeJ. QueueQ pays live/probe/dead retirement and source-zero checkpoint counts;N<=B(1+V+Q),LQ<=B-Q/(2w) and exponential queue drift hold independently of vetoA/deathxi. Forz=1+V,pending-credit p^e_(r,s)(z)=sum_(l<s)binom(r+l-1,l)G^r a_e(z)^l/[G+1/2+a_e(z)]^(r+l),G=3g/2,a_e=eta max(z-1-d_e,0)/2. It bounds fastest progress/slowest abort;fresh p_M,J<=binom(M+J-1,J-1)(6g/(eta z))^M. Phi=z^h+K_h z^(h-1)sumcredits cancels positive commits;veto only deletes credit. Add queue power toF,comparablez^h+Q^kstar. A legal negative exposure has probability>=B n^-q; sampled deadlines B_J n^q pay all disruptions and queue exits. Drift gain B_J eta^-M n^(h-M+q)+B_J n^q-cn^(h-1) is negative past polynomial radius sinceM=q+3. Reward(1+N)^4 is paid. ForB={z<=R,Q<=4R},R=Btailrho^r0,r0=2+8(M+q+4),U4=E integral_0^tauB(1+N)^4<=B_J(1+N(u))^kstar. Nonaccumulating episodes use full marked nonexplosion.
